value: Play Fable II in first person: the camera sits in the hero's head, the head is hidden and the body stays in view, and you walk, fight and look around with the mouse or right stick. H switches between first and third person, for each player in split screen and online co-op. Full cutscenes, canned actions and (by default) the gun aim keep the game's own cameras.
Whether each player starts a session in first person. H switches, for whoever presses it.
